title: 7-Zip File Manager before 26.03 fails to detect archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters, allowing…
description: 7-Zip File Manager versions before 26.03 have a vulnerability where archive entry names padded with Unicode space characters are not properly detected. This allows attackers to bypass the deceptive file name warning in CPanel::IsVirus_Message by crafting archive entries that appear as benign file types (e.g., PDF) followed by ideographic spaces and a malicious extension like .hta. When such files are opened, script content can be executed via ShellExecuteExW.
